# MaxVideoAI

Plan a production, compare current models, see the exact quote, approve the spend, and generate when the brief is ready.

![Finished product video returned in a ChatGPT conversation](assets/finished-video-chatgpt.png)

## See it work

Bring the brief. MaxVideoAI turns it into a project plan with model choices that match the shot.

```bash
npx maxvideoai install
const best = chooseModel()
```

## Keep the budget visible

You stay in control of the spend. Review the exact quote before you approve a paid generation.

| Step | What you see |
| --- | --- |
| Compare | Current model options |
| Approve | The exact project quote |

## Return to the result

Pick up where the conversation left off. Approved work stays in your MaxVideoAI library, ready to recover or reuse.
